purpose: U5.1: encode a short clip on at least 3 GPU models (NVENC) and once on CPU
gpu_models_note: Minimum is 3 distinct models. NVENC is absent on some datacentre GPUs (for example A100/H100 have no NVENC); a model without NVENC must pass the CPU path and the smoke report records encoder used. Replace that model in the list if the owner wants NVENC on all three.

fixture.how: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1280x720:rate=30:duration=10 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=10 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac source.mp4

checks.expect: container exit code 0 and output.json ok=true
ffprobe: one video stream h264, height 480, one audio stream, duration within 0.3 s of 10 s
output.json encoder is nvenc on NVENC-capable GPUs, cpu otherwise; nvenc requested but unavailable fails with encoder_unavailable
output vs a CPU re-encode of the same window passes the kit's psnr_ssim verification
the same output cut to 5 s FAILS psnr_ssim verification (negative control)
a source that is an HLS playlist referencing http:// or another local file is not followed
